summary.classificationStatus: Engineering assessment of implementation route; not a measured fidelity or performance score. Upstream counts are claims in its generated catalog, not independent render certification.

spatial.label: Single-frame image / vector processing
spatial.route: Canvas/SVG for simple drawing; WebGL2 fragment passes or WebGPU/WASM for filters and compositing.
spatial.needs: Pixels, masks, optional second-layer input; explicit color/alpha semantics and output bounds.
spatial.risk: Parameter compatibility and edge behavior still require per-effect fidelity tests; a similar appearance is not AE parity.

simulation.label: Simulation and generated 3D
simulation.route: Three.js / instancing, WebGPU compute, or WASM simulation plus GPU drawing.
simulation.needs: Seed, fixed simulation clock, birth-time parameters, collision state and checkpoint/replay for seeking.
simulation.risk: Complex interactions, CPU/GPU numerical differences and exact simulation behavior need separate validation.

analysis.label: Time, analysis, tracking and deformation
analysis.route: Frame host + worker/WASM algorithms; optical flow/tracking/model inference where needed.
analysis.needs: Neighboring frames, time remapping, masks, motion fields, rigs, analysis cache or optional trained models.
analysis.risk: Cannot be recreated faithfully by a CSS filter or a one-frame shader. Quality and performance remain unmeasured.

data.label: Specialized data / VR / color pipelines
data.route: GPU shaders with depth/ID/normal/EXR data, projection metadata or a real LUT/OCIO pipeline.
data.needs: Correct auxiliary buffers, mapping conventions, color configuration and file decoders.
data.risk: A flattened MP4 loses depth/object IDs. Missing data must be reported, not silently passed through.

audio.label: Audio processing
audio.needs: PCM sample clock, channel layouts, offline mixdown and reproducible DSP settings.
audio.risk: Visual frame rendering alone does not implement audio; exact DSP and tail handling require dedicated tests.

controls.label: Expression / UI controls
controls.route: Typed capabilities bound to stable object/effect instance IDs; code expressions or sandboxed evaluation.
controls.needs: Parameter descriptors, references, animation curves and history commands.
controls.risk: These are not nine new visual filters. Expression-language parity is a separate task.
